description: BLIND held-out set 5, authored by an independent agent on 2026-10-07 without access to search results, eval output or tuning, never to be used for tuning. Targets are stratified by note kind (note 18, memory 8, quoxplan 10, commit 8, transcript 6, tasks/finding/governance 5), sampled with ORDER BY random() from the dev org. Questions are paraphrased to avoid each note's title words. Near-misses were verified absent by LIKE queries over note bodies.
